name: CongenitalHeartDiseaseStructural
title: Congenital Heart Disease (structural)
purpose: (Clinical Focus: Broad diagnosis grouper for all forms of structural congenital heart and great vessel disease.),(Data Element Scope: SNOMED CT concept hierarches),(Inclusion Criteria: Includes congenital anomalies of the heart and great vessels, congenitally aberrant coronary artery disease, and bicuspid aortic valve. Includes history of operations or procedures for repair of congenital defects.),(Exclusion Criteria: Excludes patent foramen ovale and interatrial septal aneurysm, and congenital abnormalities of peripheral arteries and veins. Also excludes congenital rhythm disorders (such as congenital heart block) and congenital cardiac neoplasms, and most congenital cardiac myopathies unless associated with other structural congenital heart disease.)
